items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: Yeah, I played with him for a long, you know, for the good while together.

ctx.x: You know, uh, did you ever know a guy from down the river named Nene Cuoco?
No, Dene Cuoco. Ernest. Ernest. I know the name good. He was his trumpet player. You know, calling the name, it makes me like a older man, but I don't know him. He was Pills' brother.
